content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for a member position at the International Olympic Committee. Tell about your experience in sports organization leadership, knowledge of the Olympic movement, and international sports diplomacy. Also describe how you have promoted sports ethics and the Olympic ideal. Length about 400 words.
